name: commit-coach
description: Rewrites lazy commit subjects into conventional commits from the staged diff, and strips AI attribution trailers

stripAttribution.title: Strip attribution
stripAttribution.description: Remove Co-Authored-By: trailers and "Generated with" lines from commit messages, and stop asking Claude to add them.

rewriteSubjects.title: Rewrite lazy subjects
rewriteSubjects.description: Rewrite subjects like "fix" or "wip", single words, subjects over 72 characters and ones without a conventional prefix.

model.title: Model
model.description: The model that writes the new subject: an alias (haiku, sonnet) or a full model id.
